articles.title: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
articles.snippet: The regulator is moving ahead with crypto market rules as the SEC also opens a new path for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: DHS’s predictive policing is unconstitutional, un-American and should be stopped
articles.snippet: Targeting Americans based on what their spending habits can tell us about their politics is an abuse of our financial system, writes Coin Center’s Laz Pieper.

articles.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points. Bitcoin tops $77,000
articles.snippet: The yen declined and BTC rose after the BOJ hiked rates to the highest level in 31 years.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.snippet: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
articles.snippet: Building on its recent market-data investment in Kaiko, S&P Global’s latest purchase targets the technological risks facing banks and asset managers onchain.
